title: ExperimentMembership
description: Manages the membership of users into experiments.

id.description: The unique ID of this membership

experiment_id.description: The ID of the experiment being issued.

subject_id.description: The ID of the subject involved with the experiment.

project_id.description: The ID of the project that owns this experiment.

app_id.description: The ID of the application that subscribed this person to the experiment.

org_id.description: The ID of the organization that owns this experiment.

timestamp.description: The timestamp that this membership was updated.

status.description: The action that the user performed for this membership
